name: ARKitScenes
description: ARKitScenes evaluates 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning in AR/VR contexts. It is based on the ARKitScenes dataset from Apple containing 5,047 indoor scenes with rich 3D annotations including depth maps, camera poses, and object bounding boxes captured with Apple devices.
typical_sota_score: Varies by task (3D detection, depth estimation); strong spatial reasoning models approach human-level on simpler tasks
reputation: Large-scale indoor 3D scene dataset from Apple; used for spatial reasoning and 3D object detection evaluation; covers diverse real-world indoor environments
notes: Published at NeurIPS 2021 (Datasets and Benchmarks track) by Apple. Contains 5,047 scenes collected using LiDAR Scanner on iPad Pro and iPhone 12 Pro. Used as a dataset for tasks like 3D object detection, depth completion, and point cloud super-resolution. When used as an LLM benchmark, typically tests spatial and relational reasoning about indoor scenes.
